text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka stood alone
on the training track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why...
My legs just won't move forward...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...
It's not like that...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I spaced out in the middle of training...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
I can't put it into words very well, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"It just didn't feel right while running.
My legs felt a bit heavy too..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Even though I don't feel sick at all, why is this happening...?

Even after letting out a sigh, Silence Suzuka
continued to stare blankly and weakly down the track.

It seems I pushed her too hard with so many races in a row.
I should probably review her schedule so she can
run comfortably and happily again...
